title: Baudot Cross-Transport T.140 Equivalence
objective: Execute Baudot BAUDOT-INTEROP-002 as a controlled Omni experiment and preserve source-transport, normalized T.140, target-transport, presentation, loss-marker, and verdict evidence across RFC 4103 RTP/RED and RFC 8865 T.140 data-channel interworking.

externalContract.pinningRule: A development PR may identify the contract while this trial is planned. Before the trial becomes runnable, Omni must pin an exact merged Baudot commit and immutable contract digest; a branch or PR reference is not sufficient evidence identity.

baudotOwns: portable T.140 presentation and transport semantics
standards-grounded test vectors and claim boundaries

requiredBeforeRunnable: merged Baudot BAUDOT-INTEROP-002 contract pinned by commit and digest
gateway harness that emits normalized T.140 observations
Omni adapter that preserves Baudot trial identity and evidence correlation
requiredBeforeProven: pinned Baudot contract identity and digest

doesNotEstablish: Baudot conformance merely because an Omni trial passes
